description: This file defines an API interface for profile-related operations in a frontend application, including fetching, updating, and retrieving historical and saved opportunities for a user.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Fetches the current user's profile data.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates user profile fields with provided payload.

methods.name: history
methods.description: Retrieves the participation history of the user.

methods.name: saved
methods.description: Retrieves the list of saved or bookmarked opportunities.
